summary_1line: After Bhishma’s fall, he urges Duryodhana to make peace and later reveals Karna’s true birth, but Karna refuses and chooses loyalty to Duryodhana.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma lies on a bed of arrows on the battlefield while Karna kneels beside him with tears, touching the grandsire’s feet.
The wounded Bhishma raises himself slightly and embraces Karna with one arm, revealing that he is Kunti’s son.
Bhishma, pierced by countless arrows yet serene in yoga, speaks to the gathered kings urging Duryodhana to make peace with the Pandavas.
